q1.rubricZh: 要点：Yes, they did.（反意疑问句要用肯定回答）
q1.explanationZh: 第一段说15位志愿者在山洞里生活，第二段说山洞里没有手机、时钟，所以回答 Yes, they did。

evidence.quote: a team of 15 volunteers did just this for up to 40 days!
The group was sent to a cave with no phone, clock, water, or light.

q2.sampleAnswer: From a well which was 45 metres underground.

keyPoints.descZh: 从地下45米深的井里取水
examples: From a well which was 45 metres underground.

q2.rubricZh: 要点：从地下45米深的井里取水。
q2.explanationZh: 第二段说志愿者从一口地下45米深的井里打水。

evidence.quote: They drew water from a well that was 45 metres underground.

q3.sampleAnswer: To test how people would respond to losing their sense of time.

keyPoints.descZh: 测试人在失去时间感时会怎样反应
examples: To test how people would respond to losing their sense of time.

q3.rubricZh: 要点：测试人们失去时间感后的反应。
q3.explanationZh: 第三段说这个“Deep Time”项目的想法，就是测试人失去时间感后会有什么反应。

evidence.quote: The idea behind it was to test how people would respond to losing their sense of time.

q4.sampleAnswer: They were observing the volunteers during their time in the cave.

keyPoints.descZh: 观察志愿者在洞里的生活
examples: They were observing the volunteers during their time in the cave.

q4.rubricZh: 要点：观察志愿者在洞穴中的表现。
q4.explanationZh: 第三段最后一句说，一些科学家在志愿者待在洞里时一直在观察他们。

evidence.quote: Some scientists had been observing the volunteers during their time in the cave.

q5.sampleAnswer: Because he wanted to stay away from the busy city life and live his life peacefully.

keyPoints.descZh: 想远离繁忙的城市生活
examples: stay away from the busy city life

q5.rubricZh: 要点：远离繁忙的城市生活；平静地生活。
q5.explanationZh: 最后一段，志愿者说远离忙碌的城市生活，他们能停下来平静地生活，所以想多待一会儿。

evidence.quote: “Away from the busy city life, we could stop to live our lives peacefully,” said one volunteer.

q6.sampleAnswer: Yes, I do. Having too much technology in our lives, such as the use of smartphones and social media, can cause stress, anxiety, and other negative effects on mental health. It will also affect our relationships with our family and friends. (Answers may vary.)

keyPoints.descZh: 表明观点并给出第一点理由
examples: Too much technology can cause stress, anxiety, and other negative effects on mental health.
It will also affect our relationships with our family and friends.

q6.rubricZh: 开放题：表明观点，并至少给出两点合理理由，各得一分。
q6.explanationZh: 这是开放题。先说“好”或“不好”，再给至少两点理由，比如用太多科技会让人有压力，也会影响和家人朋友的关系。

evidence.quote: “Away from the busy city life, we could stop to live our lives peacefully,” said one volunteer.

q7.explanationZh: 这句是“你能想象失明是什么感觉吗？”，Can you 后面接动词原形，imagine 的意思是“想象”。

q8.explanationZh: 这句是过去的事：警察“看到”一个男人走进银行。observed 是过去式，意思是“看见；观察到”，后面 enter 是动词原形，用在 observe sb. do sth. 里。
q8.tipsZh: observe sb. do sth. 看到某人做了某事

q9.explanationZh: Schools need 后面要填名词，volunteers 是“志愿者”，学校需要志愿者来帮助孩子们阅读。

q10.explanationZh: that 引导的从句，主语 a company 是第三人称单数，所以动词要加 s。produces 的意思是“生产”，生产电器的公司。

q11.explanationZh: if 引导条件句，如果工厂关闭，至少600人会“失去”工作。will 后面接动词原形，lose 的意思是“失去”。

q12.explanationZh: sets out to 后面接动词原形。examine 的意思是“仔细研究”，这项研究要详细研究气候变化可能带来的影响。

q13.explanationZh: “with no + 名词”可以换成 without + 名词，意思不变，所以填 without phones。

q14.explanationZh: 原句是一般过去时，改一般疑问句要把 Did 放在句首，后面的动词变回原形 draw。
q14.tipsZh: 过去时的一般疑问句：Did + 主语 + 动词原形

q15.explanationZh: 画线部分是 to test ...（不定式短语），表示“想法是什么”，用 What 提问，be 动词要用 was。

q16.explanationZh: 改成直接引语，要变成志愿者当时说的话：人称 they 变成 we，过去式 wanted 变成一般现在时 want。
q16.tipsZh: 直接引语的人称和时态要还原成说话人的口吻

q17.explanationZh: 先用 since 引出原因“因为他们没有时钟”，再说结果“他们按照自己的生物钟吃饭和睡觉”，注意 according to their body clocks 放在最后。

evidence.quote: Since the group didn’t have clocks, they soon lost all sense of time.
